title: Enrol in the national health service
whatHappens: Non-EU students can enrol voluntarily in the *Servizio Sanitario Nazionale* (SSN), Italy's public health service, for a flat annual fee of around €700, paid using an F24 payment form.
whoDecides: It's your choice — private insurance is also an option, but SSN enrolment gives you full access to the public system.
timing: Any time after you have your fiscal code and residency — best done early, before you actually need a doctor.
whatKimereDoes: We explain the trade-offs between SSN and private cover for your situation, and handle the enrolment paperwork if you choose SSN.
